name: Mizunashi Nadia
source:
She is half Japanese, with a Japanese father and a Romanian mother.
She was born and raised in Japan.

After graduating from the school, she moved around overseas for a while, and then worked as a casino dealer in her mother's hometown, Romania.

She was scouted there and started working at the Northern Lights casino.
This voyage was her first job at the Northern Lights.

She is fearless and is the type of person who says what she wants to say no matter who she is talking to.
She is usually a friendly older sister, and quickly becomes friends with Miho, Jun, and the others.

She has learned self-defense techniques since she was a child, and is merciless towards bad customers.
Because of this, in Romania, she was treated as a bodyguard in addition to being a dealer.
